import json, os, sqlite3, sys
from PIL import Image, ImageFilter, ImageStat
root=sys.argv[1]
db=os.path.join(root,'backend/data/app.db')
ids=['cc9afbef-917b-45d0-9912-32b6ff10caf2','7af5dbcf-3713-4812-b9e3-868156755b75','063c007c-17e2-4c70-a2a4-b37da0772c28']
c=sqlite3.connect(db); c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row

def dhash(im):
    g=im.convert('L').resize((9,8))
    px=list(g.getdata()); bits=0
    for y in range(8):
        for x in range(8):
            bits=(bits<<1)|(px[y*9+x]>px[y*9+x+1])
    return bits

def ham(a,b): return (a^b).bit_count()
for place_id in ids:
    place=c.execute('select id,title,cover_photo_id from place where id=?',(place_id,)).fetchone()
    photos=c.execute("select id,original_path,public_path,thumb_path,caption from photo where place_id=? and status='approved' order by case when id=? then 0 else 1 end, approved_at, created_at",(place_id,place['cover_photo_id'])).fetchall()
    out=[]
    hashes={}
    for p in photos:
        rel=p['original_path']
        path=os.path.join(root,'backend/storage/private',rel) if rel else None
        if path and not os.path.isfile(path):
            path=os.path.join(root,'backend/storage',rel)
        d={'id':p['id'],'caption':p['caption'] or '', 'cover':p['id']==place['cover_photo_id'],'original_path':rel}
        if not path or not os.path.isfile(path):
            d['error']='original_missing'; out.append(d); continue
        with Image.open(path) as im:
            im.load(); w,h=im.size; g=im.convert('L'); stat=ImageStat.Stat(g); mean=stat.mean[0]; std=stat.stddev[0]
            edge=g.resize((min(w,1200), max(1,round(h*min(w,1200)/w)))).filter(ImageFilter.FIND_EDGES) if w>1200 else g.filter(ImageFilter.FIND_EDGES)
            est=ImageStat.Stat(edge); edge_std=est.stddev[0]; hist=g.histogram(); n=w*h; dark=sum(hist[:13])/n*100; bright=sum(hist[243:])/n*100
            hashes[p['id']]=dhash(im)
            d.update({'width':w,'height':h,'megapixels':round(w*h/1e6,2),'bytes':os.path.getsize(path),'brightness':round(mean,1),'contrast':round(std,1),'edge_std':round(edge_std,1),'clip_dark_pct':round(dark,2),'clip_bright_pct':round(bright,2)})
        out.append(d)
    pairs=[]
    keys=list(hashes)
    for i in range(len(keys)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(keys)):
            dist=ham(hashes[keys[i]],hashes[keys[j]])
            if dist<=12: pairs.append({'a':keys[i],'b':keys[j],'dhash_distance':dist})
    print(json.dumps({'place_id':place_id,'title':place['title'],'photos':out,'similar_pairs':pairs},ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
c.close()
PY
